synthesis.body: When a gate asks "is this CI target also run locally?", build the local set from invocation positions only — recipe lines of the targets your entrypoint transitively reaches, and the argv of the scripts it spawns. Never scan the whole file for path-shaped tokens: `SAST_DIRS := tools packs packages` yields `tools`/`packs`/`packages`, which are directory prefixes of nearly every path in the repo, so prefix-based coverage marks everything covered and the gate reports clean forever. Over-extraction on the CI side is the safe direction (a spurious target forces a human to write an exemption); over-broad coverage on the local side is fatal and silent. Pin it with a self-test asserting those bare tokens are absent from the extracted set.

title: A coverage linter that reads Makefile variable assignments is permanently green
